source.author: ThePhysicist
source.text: Came to say the same, weird that so few people know about this. It's not consumer friendly and you need a software license to program it but in the end it's 100 % local, each actor or controller is self-reliant and all devices together form a local network that self-assembles into a working house automation. Program once and keep it running for years or decades. Of course it requires a lot of effort like dedicated wiring, and the stuff isn't exactly cheap.
